purpose: Describe concentration of a selected vehicle's returned charging history by site and model removal of its top charging site.
primaryGoal: Understand top-site dependency, demonstrated alternatives, and hypothetical loss exposure without mistaking a bounded observed history for lifetime coverage.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a selected vehicle; distinct charging-sessions/history/vehicle/limit key, moderate staleTime, AbortSignal forwarding and safeArray selection. No start/end or pagination traversal. Handler parses vehicle_id, pagination and date bounds and guarantees [] rather than null.
dataSources.scope: Observed returned rows, capped by the frontend to 1000, not an entire selected interval or lifetime guarantee. Backend pagination implementation, ordering, actual row completeness and live enrichment were not traced.
dataSources.trust: Page useDataState provenance historical; retained data survives refresh failure and paused refresh. Summary remains in Wh; energy display uses useUnits.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect vehicle-list dependency; not independently API-audited in this atomic scope
dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing selected-vehicle store and URL/workspace bridge
dataSources.behavior: Path/query vehicle identity precedes saved selection then first known vehicle. Page has no competing local selector. Null selection uses NoVehicleSelected with onboarding action.

dataSources.endpoint: Existing preference/formatting infrastructure; not a page-specific measurement request
dataSources.behavior: Wh formatted only on render; percentages and KPI values follow saved numeric precision/locale. What-if score values currently bypass this number-format bridge.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: One failed retained charging source can produce the global StaleRefreshWarning plus retained SourceContent message/retry in both detail cards (150-153,178-181), while the brief also labels retained measurements. These are repeated notices for one query, not independent failed sources.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing retainedMessage/errorRecovery and StaleRefreshWarning.hideRetry contracts to choose a clear primary recovery placement; keep all source labels and retained contents and preserve appropriate per-panel recovery. Do not add another retry component.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Four label/value pairs use a manual grid. Site rows also use a page-local bordered list. Both are candidates for reuse only after checking existing display/list contracts; this single-page audit does not establish cross-page extraction evidence.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing primitives for semantic label/value presentation without changing the four what-if fields or site detail. Keep specialist local rendering unless a proven existing owner preserves it.

sourceEvidence: ChargerResiliencePage.tsx:140 stacks detail panels until @3xl; :155 stacks label/value pairs until @sm.
ChargerResiliencePage.tsx:184-191 wraps site rows, breaks site labels and retains both badges.
ChartContainer.tsx:665-689 bounds and contains its viewport; the page supplies ResponsiveContainer and 340px height.

issues.detail: All returned sites are plotted on one vertical bar chart, with a fixed 64px x-axis, -30-degree labels truncated to 20 characters and 10px ticks. At narrow containers or many sites, readability and label separation are at risk; no actual overflow or viewport failure was exercised.
issues.fix: Review an adaptive presentation using existing chart primitives, larger shared tick sizing and accessible full labels. Preserve every site, order, percentage, session count and complete export/table scope; never trim data to improve the screenshot.

sourceEvidence: Page:100-103 names the chart; :113-119 provides complete site/share/sessions fallback rows.
ChartContainer.tsx:765-800 creates the hidden/forced-colors figcaption table; :686-692 hides SVG in forced colors and assigns image semantics.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden at page:142,177; what-if help has a contextual name at :147.
FadeIn.tsx:23-34 honors reduced motion in source; actual OS mode remains unverified.

issues.detail: Top site is distinguished in the chart only by the Cell color. The accessible/export projection explicitly drops isTop at 61-63, and fallback columns do not identify the top site. The KPI names the top site elsewhere, but the chart's own accessible rows cannot communicate its highlighted marker.
issues.fix: Carry a localized textual top-site designation in the chart description or a scalar status column and visible site indicator. Retain site/share/sessions and ensure the CSV remains scalar; do not restore boolean cells.

issues.detail: Score and effective-site HelpTooltip calls (28,41) omit ariaLabel and therefore both use generic More info in HelpTooltip.tsx:72. They are meaningful explanations but have indistinguishable names outside surrounding text.
issues.fix: Pass contextual localized ariaLabel for resilience score and effective-site count using existing HelpTooltip API. Keep both complete specialist help texts and contextual-help preference.

issues.detail: Shared trigger classes have no minimum hit area or padding and default sm icon is h-3.5 w-3.5 (line 45). Page uses this compact trigger three times. Source suggests a sub-24px target; actual composed target size and WCAG spacing exceptions are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Existing shared HelpTooltip owner should provide a stable target-size contract separate from icon size, preserve inline layout and focus/tooltip semantics, and verify documented spacing exceptions or 44px mobile targets. No local duplicate tooltip or page-owned shared edit.

issues.detail: What-if facts are adjacent Text blocks, not explicit term/definition associations. The single-column mobile branch preserves reading order but has no semantic grouping per pair.
issues.fix: Use semantic dl/dt/dd via existing typography as overrides or a verified existing label/value owner; preserve all four pairs, score delta and responsive order.

states.loading: Page:70 distinguishes initial loading from retained refresh; brief:67 and chart:106 show loading while persistent card shells use SourceContent.
states.empty: Successful [] yields four missing KPI values (Stats:19,24-58), chart no locations, empty what-if and sites bodies; no loaded-history lifetime claim.
states.fatalError: Page:71,107,153,181 uses fatalError only; Stats:69-70 provides QueryError recovery; all four section shells remain.
states.retained: Page:73-75 retains query data, warning at :89, detail SourceContent retained state and brief retained at Stats:68.
states.offline: StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:72-77 uses offline copy for paused retained data. Initial paused behavior depends on actual query isLoading and hasData; authored test uses a mock rather than exercising TanStack.
states.noVehicle: Page:66-68 switches to NoVehicleSelected and governed onboarding CTA rather than requesting unscoped history.
states.unknownPartial: Missing measurement issue below; analyzer currently cannot distinguish null energy from measured zero. No full-range completeness guaranteed.

issues.detail: buildSites treats invalid/null/absent energy as zero using num(s.total_energy_added_wh) ?? 0. It reports zero energyShare when total is zero (158), then analyze uses a session-frequency dependency fallback (235-236). Stats considers any nonempty site list available (19), so missing-energy rows can become apparently measured resilience/energy-share values. This is a source-proved trust risk, not proof that the current backend returns null.
issues.fix: Integration/domain owner should establish measurement availability and a partial/unknown-energy contract, distinguish genuine measured zero from missing energy, and label existing session-frequency fallback. Preserve site membership, session counts, HHI/score formula, existing zero-session behavior and raw Wh; presentation modernization must not silently change calculations.

issues.detail: Detail panels select empty only when sourceStatus is ready. If a successful empty [] is retained after a refresh failure or pause, retained SourceContent renders its notice but the what-if children are absent and the sites ul is empty (154,182-200), without their source-specific no-data explanation.
issues.fix: Keep the retained notice/retry and independently render the no-what-if/no-sites empty body inside retained content when no derived observations exist; do not replace retained sources with fatal errors.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative ShieldCheck and MapPin use fixed text-cyan-300 (142,177), while delta uses fixed rose/emerald-300 (165). These do not escalate to neon, but bypass theme-aware semantic text and give noninteractive header ornaments unnecessary accent emphasis.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued secondary/muted tokens for decorative icons and existing semantic success/danger tokens for meaningful signed delta. Preserve delta sign/text and all saved themes; measure actual composed contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Each site share is presented as an info or warning badge. At many sites this repeats colored chrome around every numeric measurement; source already uses neutral row surfaces/borders and neutral session badges.
visualIssues.fix: Retain explicit warning semantics at the existing >=50% threshold but use quieter numeric treatment for ordinary shares and preserve readable labels/units. Keep existing Badge owner rather than new status registry.

visualIssues.detail: Chart axis font sizes 10 and 11 are page-local overrides. Grid is already restrained at 0.4 opacity and the two colors reuse chartTokens rather than a local palette.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse accepted chart typography/axis tokens and retain data meaning. Do not replace global palette or reset persisted chart/theme preferences to reduce noise.

architectureIssues.detail: The synthetic unknown-location label is hardcoded English in a pure domain function. It flows directly into chart, KPI context and site list; translating groupedBy at page:188 does not translate this label.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the stable type:unknown identity and localize only this synthetic fallback at the presentation boundary; never translate/recase actual place or charger-type source labels. Catalog ownership remains outside this page audit.

architectureIssues.detail: What-if score before, after and delta interpolate raw numeric values (161,167-170) although the KPI score uses saved fmtNumber at Stats:25. These displays do not react consistently to precision/locale choices.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing useNumberFormatting for score and signed delta display only; retain original numeric summary, source export values, sign and formula.

architectureIssues.detail: The test MemoryRouter path is /charging/resilience, while App.tsx:873 mounts /charger-resilience. It renders the imported page directly, mocks vehicle/history/FadeIn and does not prove routed workspace or real query behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Future focused integration coverage should use the actual route and existing shell scope with real relevant adapters; keep existing tests and assertions. No test execution or acceptance claimed by this audit.

priority.first: Resolve missing versus measured-zero energy trust before stylistic adoption changes; preserve current formulas until the integration owner establishes explicit semantics.
